U.note: Three draggable colored sources blend across a live ASCII field with light/paint/naive models, but the paint model is only a rough geometric-mean approximation.

V.note: RGB ink mixer with a paintable ASCII canvas and three modes works, but the canvas starts blank black and the mix preview is a bare strip of glyphs.

W.note: Clean two-color ratio mixer with a shaded ASCII sphere, a ramp strip and a model toggle; correct and keyboard friendly, but the single-colour sphere shows less mixing than the others.

X.note: Paint-on-canvas mixer with pick-from-canvas and glyph ramps works, but it starts blank with a white leftover area and has a loose paint model.

Y.note: Seeded with overlapping R/G/B blobs that visibly mix, it switches between additive light and CMY paint with a themed UI and a per-cell readout.

Z.note: Two-color mixer comparing sRGB mean with linear light; correct and keyboard friendly, but the ASCII is small boxed swatches and the page is plain.
